name: openshsid-mobile
description: OpenSHSID mobile app (Cordova wrapper around the React frontend)

scripts.run:android: npm run sync:www && cordova run android
scripts.run:ios: npm run sync:www && cordova run ios
scripts.build:android: npm run sync:www && cordova build android --release
scripts.build:ios: npm run sync:www && cordova build ios --release
